WTPN21 PGTW 060200
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT (INVEST 99W)//
RMKS/
1. FORMATION OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IS POSSIBLE WITHIN
140 NM EITHER SIDE OF A LINE FROM 16.6N 150.9E TO 20.5N 140.6E
WITHIN THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS. AVAILABLE DATA DOES NOT JUSTIFY
ISSUANCE OF NUMBERED TROPICAL CYCLONE WARNINGS AT THIS TIME.
WINDS IN THE AREA ARE ESTIMATED TO BE 23 TO 28 KNOTS. METSAT
IMAGERY AT 060000Z INDICATES THAT A CIRCULATION CENTER IS LOCATED
NEAR 16.9N 150.7E. THE SYSTEM IS MOVING NORTHWESTWARD AT 14
KNOTS.
2. REMARKS: THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 99W) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 
15.6N 151.8E IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 16.9N 150.7E, APPROXIMATELY 408 NM 
NORTHEAST OF GUAM. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED SATELLITE IMAGERY (EIR) 
DEPICTS A COMPACT AND CONSOLIDATING LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC) 
OBSCURED BY BUILDING DEEP CONVECTION. RECENTLY DEVELOPED WESTERLIES 
SUGGEST THE CIRCULATION IS BEGINNING TO CLOSE ALONG THE SOUTHERN 
PERIPHERY. THE ENVIRONMENT IS FAVORABLE FOR DEVELOPMENT WITH WARM (28-29 
C) SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND LOW TO MODERATE (10-15 KTS) VERTICAL 
WIND SHEAR, OFFSET BY WEAK OUTFLOW ALOFT AND RELATIVELY DRIER AIR TO THE 
WEST AND SOUTH OF THE CIRCULATION. GLOBAL DETERMINISTIC AND ENSEMBLE 
MODELS ARE IN AGREEMENT THAT INVEST 99W WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK WEST-
NORTHWESTWARD TOWARD GUAM AS IT CONSOLIDATES OVER THE NEXT 24-48 HOURS. 
GFS AND ECMWF DEPICT 99W RETAINING TROUGH-LIKE CHARACTERISTICS UNTIL 
WEST OF THE NORTHERN MARIANAS, THOUGH ELEVATED WINDS ARE POSSIBLE PRIOR 
TO 99W BECOMING A WELL-DEFINED OR CLOSED CIRCULATION. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED 
SURFACE WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 23 TO 28 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL 
PRESSURE IS ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 1011 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE 
DEVELOPMENT OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS 
IS HIGH.
3. THIS ALERT WILL BE REISSUED, UPGRADED TO WARNING OR CANCELLED BY 
070200Z.//
NNNN
